passages.note: A reporter's sentence that he "voted against it" is the reporter's account of the act, not the record (H15), so only his quoted words are coded here, and they name no removal clause.

rows.reasoning: The only passage is his own quoted words against HCR 2060 — "The measure will not make it safer, it will not save us money, it will costs us unnecessary and irreversible harm," — which names no policy clause and so cannot reach "Stop deportations entirely and protect undocumented immigrants from removal" or any other rung. The snapshot describes the measure only as "allowing local law enforcement officers to arrest those who cross the border illegally", which is arrest of border crossers rather than how far the government should go in deporting undocumented immigrants. His vote is reported only by a news story, so it is not a record and cannot carry the row.
